data.body:
[P2] Enforce the configured session lifetime

`AgentcoreSessionConfig.timeout` documents the session lifetime, including durable waits, but this implementation only validates it. With `timeout: { seconds: 1 }` and a handler awaiting a ten-second `child.wait`, the handler completes successfully and cleanup runs only afterward. Neither `runInChildContext` nor `stopSession` receives the timeout, so nothing enforces the requested bound. Enforce the lifetime through a durable timeout that triggers session cleanup, and add a regression test covering a handler suspended beyond that deadline.
